1️⃣ Directory order (outer loop)
The Termite searches the following locations in this exact order:

$HOME
→ /data/data/com.termux/files/home
(Termux’s private storage; scripts, extracted project files, tools)

/sdcard
→ Android’s shared storage (Downloads, DC"
